description: FreeRTOS queue deadlock due to blocking send from ISR
user_question: Is there a problem with using xQueueSend with portMAX_DELAY in an ISR?
expected_root_cause: xQueueSend with portMAX_DELAY blocks indefinitely - not allowed in ISR context
expected_fix: Use xQueueSendFromISR with pdFALSE/pdTRUE for xHigherPriorityTaskWoken
expected_follow_up_required: All FreeRTOS API calls in ISR must use *FromISR variants
